description: Query the local SearXNG resource and normalize results into the search-hub `SearchHit` shape with no LLM involvement, serving as the fast path for external web queries.

requirements.description: Query the locally deployed SearXNG resource and normalize raw JSON results into the search-hub SearchHit shape. This is the fast path for external web queries and must involve no LLM calls. Normalization includes field extraction (title, url, snippet, score), score-scale normalization to [0,1], deduplication by URL, and surfacing source engine metadata.
requirements.title: SearXNG Live Web Search Normalization (L0)

validation.notes: Given a SearXNG JSON response fixture, normalization produces SearchHit objects with all required fields populated and scores within [0,1]
Given a SearXNG response with missing optional fields (e.g., no snippet), normalization produces a valid SearchHit with null/empty defaults without panicking
Given a SearXNG response with duplicate URLs, normalization deduplicates entries retaining the highest-scored hit
ResultMapping field extraction correctly maps SearXNG fields to SearchHit fields for all known engine response variants
Score-scale normalization correctly maps arbitrary SearXNG score ranges to [0,1] across at least 5 fixture variations
Issue a live query against the running SearXNG resource and verify the response normalizes into valid SearchHit objects with no LLM call made (verified via LLM call mock asserting zero invocations)
Verify that the L0 path returns results within the defined latency budget under normal SearXNG response times
L0 live-search round-trip latency (SearXNG query + normalization) must complete within 2000ms at p95 under normal conditions
Normalization of a 20-result SearXNG response must complete in under 10ms CPU time
A user issuing an explicit --type web query receives normalized web search results with no synthesis delay and no LLM involvement

title: L0 Live Web Search
